adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the placeholder assignment `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token";` executes regardless of whether the sync path is active (it’s after the `if/else` choosing `minimumTokenResponseSchema` vs `schema`). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token data is spread over existing credentials: `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`. Since `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws on non-success, `tokenResponse.success` will be true and `tokenResponse.data.refresh_token` will be the literal placeholder when the provider doesn’t return a refresh_token, overwriting the previously stored real refresh token. That would permanently break refresh for that credential.
